subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should this stale local Anthropic Vertex client branch be retired in favor of the current-main provider SDK upgrade, or refreshed as the chosen auth-provider implementation?
rationale: The old audit/auth dependency chain is already removed on current main by a different merged dependency update, while this PR is protected, conflicting, not maintainer-editable, and still changes auth-provider behavior beyond a pure dependency repair.

options.title: Retire This Branch After Main-Path Verification
options.body: Close or supersede this PR once maintainers confirm the current-main `@anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk` 0.19.0 path plus issue https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95366 cover any remaining release/live proof work.

options.title: Refresh The Branch On Current Main
options.body: Rebuild the PR against current main only if maintainers still want a local Vertex client instead of the official SDK, preserving provider package metadata, shrinkwrap, plugin-sdk imports, and cache-control tests.

options.title: Accept The Local Client Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the local BaseAnthropic/GoogleAuth implementation, but that should come with explicit auth-provider approval and live Vertex ADC evidence.

recommendation.title: Retire This Branch After Main-Path Verification
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this PR once maintainers confirm the current-main `@anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk` 0.19.0 path plus issue https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95366 cover any remaining release/live proof work.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored both the stale candidate branch and the merged current-main dependency update that now covers the central dependency chain.
